ELECTRICITY — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #18
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

2. When learning D.C Electric Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for D.C Electric Circuits.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for D.C Electric Circuits.
   C. Skip safety briefings for D.C Electric Circuits.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after D.C Electric Circuits.

3. When learning D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for D.C Electric Circuits 1.3 Cells and Batteries 1.4 Capacitors and Capacitance 1.5.

4. When learning Introduction to Electricity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
